Image 1 is the existing hurdle DESIGN to redraw from a different camera angle. Image 2 is the actual tiny horse SPRITE for pixel style and scale.

Tiny native source drawing approximately 28 pixels wide by 32 high: slender posts only 2-3 pixels wide and 10-12 pixels tall, crossbar only 2 pixels thick. Individual hard-edged flat pixel clusters, match the 26x18 horse reference. No thick outline around the whole object. Maximum 7 restrained colors: dark walnut, medium muted brown, small golden wood highlight, ivory cream, darker cream shade, muted red band, dark brown underside. Minimal details only.
One complete centered sprite on true transparent alpha with generous margins. NO ground plane or grass patch, NO cast shadow, NO scenery, NO other objects, NO labels, NO smooth shading, NO gradients, NO noise, NO realistic wood grain, NO 3D render, NO lighting bloom, NO antialiasing. It should look like a small hand-drawn pixel game prop, with clear three-quarter construction. Keep the slim lightweight character of the original hurdle while showing side faces and height.
